text:
maya: thinking out loud — could we build a small in-console "Decision Simulator" that lets PMs/SEs author fallback scenarios and run them against recorded traffic? a lightweight 'scenario writer' inside rollouts UX.

sam: yes, been wanting a playground like that. main questions: data access (replay vs synthetic), security (PII in traces), and how to surface results (summary vs trace).

lia: UX idea: two panes — left: scenario builder (blocks: trigger, error profile, degrade actions), right: preview + trace timeline. quick toggles for noise sampling and timeframe.

igor: replaying recorded traffic needs scrubbed payloads. we should gate replay to Dedicated/private or sampled hosted traces with PII redaction. otherwise only synthetic or sanitized replay.

maya: agreed. UX should default to synthetic + canned examples. add a 'run on sampled real traffic' checkbox, disabled for orgs without redaction keys.

toni: on the API side, we'd offer an endpoint /sim/run that accepts {policy, sample_rate, window, seed}. returns {summary, traces[], metrics}. keep it async; runs can be long.

nina: from telemetry: we want to capture decision traces and a lightweight audit crumb for each simulated request so we can compare baseline vs scenario. also perf counters (latency per-kvcache hit rate, tokens saved).

sam: can we reuse the existing playback infra? We'll need a shim that maps recorded requests into the simulator format, plus a mode that fakes external service failures (5xx, timeouts) and model fallbacks.

maya: for the UI, include a quick export button: "Export as runbook" that produces a JSON policy + human-friendly notes for ops handoff. also a 'dry-run to staging' action that pushes scenario as a canary policy in staging environment.

lia: small mock for builder blocks:

```
- trigger: "error_rate > 2%"
- error_profile: {type: "model_error", rate: 0.3}
- action: {type: "switch_model_variant", variant: "quantized-low-latency"}
- audit: {sample: 0.1, trace_level: "detailed"}
```

sam: love the blocks. need to decide which parts are editable in-console vs read-only from policy repos. My vote: full edit in UI, but saving requires a sign-off if it touches protected fields (routing rules, quotas).

igor: ops-bot thought: when running real-traffic sims, tag results in audit log with "simulated=true" and add TTL so they don't pollute long-term billing analytics. also rate-limit sim runs per-org to avoid accidental large replays.

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered: "Reminder: sandbox sim runs consume ephemeral compute — limit 2 concurrent per org" :information_source: 

toni: implementation note: instrument the sim API to emit a small, consistent telemetry envelope with keys: scenario_id, seed, sample_rate, switched_models[], metrics_hash. that will make downstream diffs easier.

nina: for dashboards, produce a single diff view: baseline vs scenario (error rate, p99 latency, token cost). small table + sparklines. and link each row to the decision trace playback.

maya: ux question: should we visible-by-default surface 'degrade modes' (soft degrade: partial responses / truncate; hard degrade: full fallback)? product wants both, but hide advanced settings under "expert" mode.

lia: suggest: two presets: "gentle" and "aggressive" + advanced panel. keep primary flow simple.

sam: big internal API debate: do we treat a simulation-run as a first-class rollout object (so we can apply canaries, aborts, rollbacks) or as ephemeral job results? I'd prefer ephemeral with optional 'promote to rollout' hook.

maya: promote-to-rollout sounds ideal — editors can iterate, validate, then promote. must require approval if routing/quota changes.

igor: final checklist from ops: PII-safe replay gating, concurrency limits, audit flagging, TTL on sim artifacts, quota for sim compute. once those are in place I'm ok with a staged rollout.

sam: I'll draft a minimal API spec and wireframe for Lia. Toni and Igor — can you review the security+infra constraints? Maya — will schedule a quick sync.

maya: thanks — I'll put a short PRD in the rollout board and attach Lia's mock. quick ask: add a sample scenario library (e.g., "region outage", "model OOM", "latency spike from kvcache miss").

lia: noted. I'll add two micro-interactions: export/run and trace playback scrubber.

toni: i'll start the API stub this week and add telemetry contract to the schema repo.

nina: will prototype the diff dashboard widgets and metrics selectors.

maya: perfect. follow-ups: sam/toni/igor review by EOD Fri, then 1-hour design sync next Tue. :calendar: :rocket:
